purpose: Side bucket for P6B items that could not be implemented safely. Items here are NOT certified and stay fail-closed (not installable / not executable). Rendered to docs/audits/vehicles/p6b-deferred-work.md by tools/audits/vehicles/build-p6b-deferred-work.mjs.

items.reason: Hit points increase by a percentage; the book gives no rounding rule, and it is unruled whether the percentage applies to printed HP only or also to other HP increases.
options: percentage of printed HP only vs current maximum
items.impact: 3 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Owner rules on V-P6-01; the effect is a one-line hp kind in the effects registry once ruled.

items.source: Starships of the Galaxy p. 41, Table 3-3
items.reason: Every published hull already has a sublight speed; installing a drive is a replacement, which is unruled (same question as shields/hyperdrives). The 'military vessels only' clause for the fastest drives has no hull 'military' attribute in canonical data.
items.missing: Replacement rule (refund, EP of the old drive); a source-backed military-hull classification.
options: replacement frees the old drive's EP
replacement keeps the old EP consumed
replacement not allowed on stock hulls
items.impact: 6 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable; starship-scale speed is never changed by the Shipyard.
items.recommendedAction: Owner rules on V-P6-02; then decide how a hull is classified as military (data field) before enabling the fastest drives.

items.reason: The rule is printed clearly, but applying it needs an effect on ANOTHER vehicle: a swift action that picks a target within 6 starship squares, a per-target size-based penalty on Use Computer (communications/sensors) and on fire control (not reducing the Intelligence modifier below +0), and an opposed Use Computer check. None of these consumers exists: no starship-scale range measurement, no cross-actor temporary condition store, and fire control is not used by any executable weapon (V-P2-04).
items.missing: Cross-vehicle temporary effect state, starship-scale range check, opposed-check flow, fire-control penalty consumer.
items.impact: 2 rows stay SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Build after weapon execution (V-P2-04) exists, using the combat ActiveEffect path for the target condition.

items.reason: Effects are 'treated as one size smaller when targeted by capital-ship weapons' and 'treated as a starfighter for dogfighting and starship combat maneuvers'. The system has no dogfight eligibility check, no starship-maneuver eligibility by size, and no executable capital-ship weapon targeting.
items.missing: Dogfight / starship maneuver eligibility consumer; capital-weapon targeting (blocked by V-P2-04).
items.impact: Row stays SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.
items.recommendedAction: Implement as a size-category override read by the dogfight and capital-weapon targeting code once those exist.

items.reason: The printed text says only that it stores two jumps' worth of information. It does not state whether it grants the navicomputer's +5 astrogation bonus, or what happens on a third jump.
items.missing: Bonus value (if any) and the consequence of exceeding two stored jumps.
options: no astrogation bonus; storage limit only
same +5 as a standard navicomputer while within its two stored jumps
items.impact: Row stays SOURCE_VERIFIED and not installable.

items.reason: The +5 bonus is integrated. Any trained-only gate for astrogation in the skill roller is not vehicle-aware, so a navicomputer clause about untrained astrogation has no consumer; the roll is never blocked by the vehicle code either way.
items.missing: A trained-only check consumer for Use Computer (astrogate) that can see the vehicle.
items.impact: No incorrect mechanic: the bonus applies; the training permission is not enforced either way.
items.recommendedAction: Wire when the skill roller gains trained-only enforcement for skill uses.

items.reason: The row's effect text is legacy and unverified; the census does not match it to a printed SotG row.
items.missing: A printed source for the component and its effect.
items.recommendedAction: Locate a printed source or retire the legacy row.
